title: Best Theme Parks in Europe for Families
description: The best family theme parks in Europe: Disneyland Paris, Efteling, Europa-Park, PortAventura, LEGOLAND Billund, Parc Astérix and Tivoli, with tips for each.
h1: The best theme parks in Europe for families
intro: Europe is packed with world-class theme parks, many easy to reach from the UK. Here’s Scout’s guide to the best for families, and who each one suits.

image.alt: Fireworks over a fairy-tale castle at night

cardText: Disneyland Paris, Efteling, Europa-Park, PortAventura and more.

blocks.title: Scout’s Europe picks
blocks.text: Young kids: Efteling’s Fairytale Forest and LEGOLAND Billund. Mixed ages: Disneyland Paris and Europa-Park. Sun plus rides: PortAventura.
points: Most parks use date-based online pricing
Many close or reduce hours in winter
Combine with a city break or beach holiday

sections.html: Two parks: Disneyland Park and Disney Adventure World, home of World of Frozen since March 2026. Under-3s free. What’s new.
A magical park famous for its Fairytale Forest, with plenty for thrill-seekers too. Brilliant for young children.
Germany’s largest theme park, with areas themed on European countries and the Rulantica indoor water park next door. Plan two days.
On the Costa Dorada near Salou, with PortAventura Park, Ferrari Land and a water park. A great add-on to a beach holiday.
The original LEGOLAND (opened 1968), close to LEGO House. Best for ages roughly 2 to 12.
Parc Astérix, near Paris, is fun and full of character. Copenhagen’s Tivoli Gardens, opened in 1843, is one of the world’s oldest amusement parks, magical after dark.

faqs.q: What is the best theme park in Europe for young children?
faqs.a: Efteling (for its Fairytale Forest), LEGOLAND Billund and Disneyland Paris are all excellent for young children.
